description: Upgrade plan to migrate project to Java 25

tasks.reason: Java 25 is the latest LTS release, providing long-term support, improved performance, and access to new language features and APIs.
tasks.requirements: Upgrade the JDK/Java version to 25. Update build configuration (pom.xml or build.gradle) to target Java 25. Ensure all compiler settings, toolchain configurations, and CI/CD pipelines reference Java 25. Do not upgrade Spring Boot, Spring Framework, or perform Jakarta EE migration unless separately requested.
tasks.summary: Upgraded Java version from 21 to 25. Updated pom.xml java.version property and Dockerfile base images (build and runtime stages) to use eclipse-temurin:25. BUILD SUCCESS verified with JDK 25.0.3. No CVEs found.
